description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/0302)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title ownership for multiple land parcels with detailed cadastral information, locations, and ownership details. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements.
